docs.title: Documentation Home
docs.text:
The shared technical reference for Rutgers + Rowan NASA. Find design decisions, build instructions, and development guides from Rowan's Engineering Team and Rutgers' Software Team.

New to the project?

Start with Systems & Requirements for project context, or Development Setup to get your local environment ready.

docs.text:

docs.title: Unity digital twin
docs.text:
The digital twin is a virtual lunar environment, built from Cesium's Lunaverse in Unity, where the rover can be placed, animated, and tested.

Section status

Owners: Dinh, Joshua, Nicole Status: In progress

docs.title: What's in this section
docs.text:
• Digital twin

    Notes, building, and assets.

  • Rover physics

    Wheels, mass, lunar gravity, and terrain collision.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• Import Cesium and Lunaverse environments into Unity
  • A framework for defining assets and connecting them to the Lunaverse
  • Terrain collision using Mesh Colliders
  • Rover physics with a mass system
  • Lunar gravity and lunar-specific environment settings
  • Rover movement animations, including rotating wheels
  • Integration of pathfinding into the rover's movement

docs.title: Stretch goals
docs.text:
• Dust particles on the wheels to simulate moon dust
  • Better rover models
  • Visualization of the pathfinding route

docs.title: How this connects to other sections
docs.text:
• Pathfinding decides where the rover drives: Path-finding algorithm
  • VR lets users explore this environment: Unity VR

docs.title: Open questions
docs.text:
• Is there an existing lunar rover model, or a schematic to model from?
  • Which assets already exist for the Lunaverse?
  • Which behaviors are physically simulated, and which are only visual?

docs.title: Contributing to this section
docs.text:
1. Copy an existing page in this folder as a starting point.
  2. Add it to nav in mkdocs.yml.
  3. Link it from the "What's in this section" cards above.
  4. To track ownership, please write the contributers (including your name) of that page.
